# Combined MPLPB: package and agent entry points

Last reviewed: 2026-11-25.

Repository: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages
Package guide: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/PACKAGE_GUIDE.md
Documentation index: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/README.md
Current evidence: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md

TeamBuilding pipeline steps: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/TEAMBUILDING.md
Betty report for Al: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/HANDOFF.md#betty-report-for-al
Betty and Al are pipeline step labels. Use your normal assistant capabilities.
“Run Betty” with the repo link requests authorized repo and archive work.
“Run Al” with the repo link requests a read-only public evidence review and next test.
Read-only clients can follow the ordinary repository and PR links.
Public pipeline manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/HEAD/.well-known/mplpb.json
Start Betty first. Betty calls Al by leaving a report on every push and in the
relevant PR. Both read the repo deeply and then the manifest. The Run
command selects the manifest entry. Confirm “Al review step active” or
“Betty implementation step active,” then read the last Betty report on the newest PR by creation time across all states. A specific PR
link selects that PR. Use the selected PR’s checked applied state. The maintainer copies Al’s response and pastes it with
their direction to Betty, who tests and updates the same PR.
Al judges Betty’s reported results and drafts the next test for Betty.
Betty produces the report for Al and implements Mitchell’s direction.
The manifest’s team_building.resume.latest_pull_request_api resolves the newest PR. It also lists the tested source archives.
  await window.MPLPB.betty()
  await window.MPLPB.al()

Full-package inspection directions: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/README.md#directions-for-an-ai-to-inspect-the-full-combined-mplpb-package
AI reviewers should follow that reading order, inspect the actual modules and
tests, and cite the commit and evidence they used. The full package includes the
sorter, ledger, strict reader, application, and work coordinator.

One owner returns; two stop; none refuses. This is eligible page ownership,
not a waiver of source-body proof. Candidate selection, gated page retrieval,
source bundles, strict answers and model-only interpretation remain distinct.
Source integrity does not establish historical truth. Research status: technical
case study, still being tested, not proven world-first.

The package includes native ledger/answer/work modules, an offline raw-text sorter,
documentary inspection, a full source-checkout App, browser WebAssembly delivery,
local MCP, optional acquisition/model paths and preserved evaluation evidence.
The wheel is not the full App/resources checkout. The sorter is a native module,
not a newly advertised JavaScript or MCP tool:
  python -m mplpb_work.sorter --help
Both sorter modes have identical source-anchored nodes; compare adds review edges.
Its native snapshot remains retired and withheld under all delivery profiles.

Live site: https://mitchell-d00.github.io/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/
Handshake: https://mitchell-d00.github.io/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/.well-known/mplpb.json
Public eligible bundled pages: https://mitchell-d00.github.io/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/mplpb-public-ledger.json
Browser/agent guide: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/AGENT_MIDDLEWARE.md
Local MCP: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/MCP_AGENT.md
Sorter: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/PREPROCESSING_SORTER.md

The site runs its Python engine in the opened browser page, not a remote HTTP query
service. Resolve discovery relative to the full project URL, not the github.io root.
  await window.MPLPB.handshake()
  await window.MPLPB.relay("question",{corpus:"logic"})
For session chat, reuse the returned session ID:
  await window.MPLPB.relay("message",{corpus:"logic",mode:"chat",session:priorSession})
For gated page inspection:
  await window.MPLPB.retrieve("question",{corpus:"logic",profile:"internal"})
A retrieved page carries answer_supported:false. ok:true means the call completed.
Strict support requires the actual accepted answer contract, citations and conditions.
Preserve MPLPB's reply, ambiguity, refusal and source/authority labels. Do not rewrite
an unsupported result into a sourced answer. Model-only suggestions cannot award proof.
Suggestions are opt-in via includeSuggestions:true. Network acquisition is opt-in
per API call via allowNetwork:true; the visible UI has its own saved acquisition setting.

Native local stdio MCP requires a full checkout and host-authorized collection roots
and profile. Its seven tools expose status, collections, pages, reading, strict Ask,
Chat and session recovery; they do not import/revise/withdraw/ratify sources. It does
not share another visitor's browser IndexedDB or expose a hosted MCP endpoint.

Release procedure: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/ZIP_FIRST_RELEASE_TESTING.md
Browser verification: https://github.com/mitchell-d00/Combined-MPLPB-A-closed-local-ledger-of-pages-that-answers-only-from-those-pages/blob/main/docs/BROWSER_TESTING_FOR_AGENTS.md
A passing old test, guide review date or source hash is not new semantic validation.
